message: schema at V_path does not re-canonicalise to the same bytes: V_detail
why: schemas[].json is embedded verbatim and participates in the type hash. If re-encoding changes even one byte, an offline build and a signature check disagree about which schema was signed.
fix: emit the schema with keys in byte order and no whitespace
or report the frontend that produced it — this is normally a codegen bug
